nodes.label: Crowded Pedestrian Crossing Test Image
nodes.description: Elevated/oblique photograph of a very busy urban scissor crossing (Shibuya-style) with roughly 60-80 pedestrians walking in multiple directions across white zebra stripes; many wear face masks and carry bags or umbrellas. Used as an unlabelled qualitative test input for the YOLOv4 Keras detector: it exercises the 'person' class at high instance density, heavy mutual occlusion, small object scale and a strongly patterned high-contrast background.

nodes.label: Dense Small-Object Detection Under Occlusion
nodes.rationale: A crowd image is chosen as a smoke test because the hardest failure modes of a one-stage anchor-based detector show up here: NMS merging adjacent same-class boxes, small-scale instances falling below the stride of the coarse detection head, and repetitive stripe texture producing background false positives. If the detector holds up on a dense human crowd it is plausible it will hold up on a dense flock, which is the actual target domain of the project.
